rationale: The feature guide lists Platform 10.1.x+, SAIA 2.1.0+, 15 AWS regions and Model Runtime/enablement. The documented CMP route also describes inbound 8089 and certificate conditions. Cloud Connected installation and SAIA-9918 explicitly exclude 2.2.0–2.3.6; the 2.1.1 workaround omits Agent Mode, and 2.4.0 support is planned. Model Runtime separates Global and Data zone routing and allows third-party inference when enabled. Cloud installation and limited IL2 evidence are scoped separately.
